name: travel-agents
description: Agents for cited, checked research. travel-agent is the single entry point for a trip (stay, itinerary, or both) that gathers its own requirements and ranks by one auditable rank score; staycation-finder and vacation-planner remain directly invocable for a known mode. All three share one pool of skills and tools. A fact-guard gate blocks any report whose figures lack stored captures, a fresh second look, or allowed sources.
